beats.why: The caption only credits Stolen Focus and never names Graceland or Elvis, so a blind viewer misses the trip the narration is setting up.
The bewildered teenage employee is drawn as the exhausted 30-something office worker, so a blind viewer reads a different person making the request.
Gloria Mark stays on screen through the pivot to Earl Miller, so a blind viewer would credit the coming cost claim to her instead of the neuroscientist.
beats.callout: NO FULL HOUR OF UNBROKEN WORK

beats.why: The caption states the sensory-channel claim flatly, so a blind viewer hears an assertion where the narrator is actually posing a skeptical question.
The lit lightbulb implies ideas are still firing on a beat where the narration says innovation and original thought do not happen.
A GRIM SCENE is too bare and inherits the river imagery, so a blind viewer reads a grim river instead of the wartime camp the narration is travelling toward.
The 70-year-old psychologist is the only figure shown, so a blind viewer takes him to be the imprisoned brother rather than Mihaly.
FATHER OF FLOW captions the same seated man the narration calls Moritz, the broken prisoner, so the viewer would believe flow's father is the ruined man.
A big boulder stands in for what the narration calls a small crystal-like shimmering rock, so the object the viewer sees is a different thing.
The 70-year-old psychologist is shown studying the rock though the narration credits that study to Moritz the prisoner, not Mihaly.
The absorbed figure is the 70-year-old psychologist, so the viewer credits the vanishing of cold and hunger to the wrong man.
After a brutal workday covers only the setup, so a blind viewer misses the turn where the narrator pushes back on the finding.
The vague label vital biological mechanism names no mechanism, so the lingering light scene fills the gap and the viewer hears it as light-driven alertness instead of the narrated glymphatic cleanup.
The words produce metabolic waste drop the time cue, so the viewer places waste production during sleep rather than during the narrated daytime neural firing.
Look at a web page merely restates the literal topic and conveys nothing about the scan-skip-extract habit being described.
Read the headline labels only one step of the narrated F-pattern, reducing a multi-stage scan to a single action.
Deep sustained reading is a bare label that never says what it does to human relations, leaving the Maher finding unstated.
You lose other people's worlds beside the absorbed slumped reader inverts the logic, so the viewer hears that deep reading itself erases others' inner lives rather than that losing stamina does.
More words than ever in history, read as words in existence, shifts the argument from how much text is read to how much text exists.
beats.callout: More words than ever in history

beats.why: STRESS SENDS WANDERING TO THREAT swaps the narrated destination of rumination and anxiety for threat-scanning, so the viewer leaves with a threat-alert belief.
The bare caption "The sixth force" let the blind viewer read only a list position and lose the narration's payload that the fearful environment was deliberately built, not an accident.
The caption "Heart of the machine" was read as the machine's core being the ancient pre-verbal fear system, whereas the narration says the named engineers are the heart of the machine.
The vague caption "Something chilling" plus a dinner-plate icon let the viewer invent a reveal (machine built around fear) while missing the narrated scene of free organic food and beanbag chairs.
With "Sold to advertisers" as the only anchor the blind viewer heard a data-resale line and missed the actual reveal in the narration, that Aza Raskin invented the infinite scroll.
The "Click for next page" caption let the viewer read the old interface as a bait to keep scrolling, whereas the narration presents that click as protective friction.
The untagged caption "Giving consumers what they want" let the blind viewer take the counterargument for the narrator's own position instead of a claim being examined.
The caption "Read a challenging book" turned the narration's personal example of a higher goal into a piece of advice to the viewer.
With no caption or diagram, the slumped worker conveyed only exhaustion and gave the blind viewer nothing to read about the narrated list of assaults on focus.
The bare caption "DEER IN THE FOREST" over a forest background read as another list entry, losing the analogy that a rent-stressed brain cannot do spreadsheet work.
"NOT LAZY OVERNIGHT" was read as "not fixable overnight by trying harder," a different claim from the narration's "nobody suddenly became lazy, the food supply changed."
The caption "outruns the strict science" stripped the "to maintain the narrative of victimhood" half, so the blind viewer heard a neutral concession rather than a charge of overclaiming.
The imperative-sounding caption "put the phone down" turned the narration's warning about losing agency and total structural determinism into a call to action.
The caption "freely choosing to look" stated the aspiration but lost the narration's accusatory half about a boardroom engineer having set up this exact moment.
